title: Absorbing discrete diffusion language model

paper.title: Structured Denoising Diffusion Models in Discrete State-Spaces

statement: Implement Absorbing discrete diffusion language model: implement absorbing-mask corruption and reverse token prediction on text8 or TinyShakespeare. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use tinyshakespeare; required output: Corrupted tokens time -> clean-token logits. Evaluate token_nll (minimize). Absorbing transition rows sum to one; distinguish mask and padding. Required ablation: Compare uniform and absorbing transition kernels at equal denoiser calls. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
